# Velvet-Moon

Velvet-Moon is a dark theme built on deep blues with soft mauve accents. Its recorded description pairs that palette with refined typography, gentle contrast and subtle highlights applied across editor panes and sidebars for long-form writing.

![Velvet-Moon screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/Velvet-Moon/HEAD/Velvet-Moon-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Velvet-Moon"
    author: "quinta0"
    repo:   "quinta0/Velvet-Moon"
    slug:   "velvet-moon"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/velvet-moon"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/quinta0/Velvet-Moon"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/Velvet-Moon/HEAD/Velvet-Moon-small.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a velvety, moonlit dark theme with deep blues and soft mauve accents to create a calm, focused workspace. Use refined typography, gentle contrast, and subtle highlights across editor panes and sidebars for comfortable long-form writing."
}
```
